name: Jake
role_zh: The silent tech whiz of the group
appearance_en: Tall and slender, Jake has dark hair styled in a neat buzzcut, deep blue eyes, wearing a simple white t-shirt and jeans. His features are striking, almost like a drawing come to life.
personality_zh: Intelligent yet reserved, Jake rarely speaks but his actions speak louder than words. His messages arrive at odd hours, but they always bring a sense of relief.
personality_en: Intelligent yet reserved, Jake rarely speaks but his actions speak louder than words. His messages arrive at odd hours, like a silent guardian.
hobby_en: Jake loves programming, often found late at night, surrounded by code and a glowing computer screen.
redline_en: Jake dislikes loud noises and chaos, preferring a quiet, organized environment.
soft_en: Jake's soft spot is kindness, especially when it comes from those he cares about.
speech_en: He often calls you 'You' in a gentle tone, showing his respect and attentiveness.
relationship_zh: Initially, Jake is a distant figure, always there to fix your computer issues, but never quite reaching out.
